Hymn 198: That Easter Morn

This is hymn number 198 titled "That Easter Morn" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Robert Cundick and the lyrics were written by Marion D. Hanks.
